title: Men's Doubles Gold, 2026 US Open Pickleball

source.note: Events observed from 29.97fps source frames. No averages, rates, totals, or coaching notes.

definitions.estimates: Speeds, positions, and contact heights are visual estimates from the video, in meters. Times are frame-measured, in seconds.
definitions.server: From the serve record of each rally: server, first or second server, score call, and serving side.
definitions.rally_winner: From the outcome record of each rally: the winning team, and the winner or the player who made the error.
definitions.serve_points_won: Rallies served by the team that scored a point for it.
definitions.side_outs: Rallies received by the team that it won, taking the serve back.
definitions.deep: A serve or return that lands within 1.5 m of the baseline.
definitions.kitchen_landing: An in-bounds bounce in a kitchen zone. Only logged bounces count; a ball volleyed out of the air has none.
definitions.kitchen_line: A position inside the player's own kitchen or up to 0.75 m behind it.
definitions.kitchen_time: Share of 10 Hz position samples at the kitchen line.
definitions.kitchen_arrival: Rallies where the player reached the kitchen line, and seconds from the serve to getting there.
definitions.both_at_kitchen: Share of moments when both partners stood at the kitchen line together.
definitions.partner_spacing: Distance between partners at the same moment, in meters.
definitions.distance: Distance covered, measured between position samples 0.5 s apart so tracking jitter does not add up.
definitions.contact_height: Contact height above the net top. Heights more than 0.914 m below it are under the ground and left out.
definitions.heat: Counts of position samples per court cell, row by row from the grid origin in court.heat.
definitions.line_call: line_call_confidence on each bounce: 0 to 1, how sure the in or out call is.
definitions.lanes: Left, middle, and right thirds of the court width, as seen in the video.
definitions.targeted: Opponent shots this player answered, out of those their team answered.
definitions.first_attack: The first contact in a rally logged as an attack.
definitions.rally_length: Buckets of logged contacts per rally.
definitions.point_sources: Scored points by how they were won. An ace is a serve the other team did not return. An attack is a point closed by a logged attack. A winner is any other winning shot. An opponent error is a point won from the other team’s error.
